requirements.statement: Once the PR has merged, the run record (shipped.json) is detached to <git common dir>/ensemble/ship/<state dir name>/<startedAt>.json whatever the merge step records (merged, a stop after gh pr merge landed, or a stop on a PR merged by hand with data.merged true). With the tracked file gone, start --resume continues at the merge step's recorded outcome, not step 1.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives, row O1 (must pass: yes; source: reproduction block 1 and owner instruction 2026-11-08)

requirements.statement: When the sequencer detaches, custody.json (verified-code anchor and its moves) is detached into the same folder, named by the run's startedAt; custody.js reads and writes it there from then on and stays its only writer, so an anchor move made after the merge survives the branch being deleted.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives, row O2 (must pass: yes; source: owner instruction 2026-11-08)

requirements.statement: With no tracked record, start --resume loads a detached record only when its work kind, id and branch match what start was given; otherwise a fresh run begins. start writes a pointer in the same folder naming the startedAt of the run it loaded or created, and next, record and status follow that pointer instead of taking the newest record by updatedAt.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives, row O3 (must pass: yes; source: reproduction block 2 and owner instruction 2026-11-08)

requirements.statement: custody.js check no longer has a push link: --link push returns the existing 'unknown link push' failure; the pr-head, merge and deploy links are unchanged.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives, row O4 (must pass: not marked; source: owner instruction 2026-11-08)

requirements.statement: Every edited file under packages/core/ has a byte-identical copy under .claude/, and npx jest packages/core/lib packages/core/contracts passes.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives, row O5 (must pass: not marked; source: owner instruction 2026-11-08)

tasks.description: Add ship-record-dir.js (recordDir, safeName, pointer read/write, currentStartedAt, custodyPath). In custody.js add detach (function and CLI verb), route readCustody/writeCustody through custodyPath, and remove the push link. Update custody.test.js. Copy to .claude/lib/; symlink in packages/full/lib/. Serves O2, O4, O5. Dependencies: none. Acceptance: custody tests (a) to (d) per TRD row FIX-001.

In ship-sequencer.js: parse detach-on-data; detach on a detach-on result or on any result whose data sets a detach-on-data key to true; on detach write the pointer and call custody.detach; delete latestExternal; loadState without a tracked file follows the pointer; start --resume loads only a kind/id/branch-matched detached record and start always writes the pointer; status reports custodyPath. Update header and CLI notes. Add Jest tests for both reproduction scenarios. Copy to .claude/lib/. Serves O1, O2, O3, O5. Dependencies: FIX-001. Acceptance: tests (a) to (f) per TRD row FIX-002, including repro.sh exiting 0.

Merge contract: add detach-on-data: merged; every stop it returns first reads gh pr view <pr> --json state and, on MERGED, carries data {merged: true, base}; the Result section says the sequencer detaches on it. ship-build.md: Step 3 passes the work's branch on --resume and states the kind/id/branch match; Step 6 reads custody from status's custodyPath. Copy both to .claude/. Serves O1, O3, O5. Dependencies: FIX-002. Acceptance: contract test (a), surface test (b), and npx jest packages/core/lib packages/core/contracts packages/core/commands plus cmp of edited files, per TRD row FIX-003.

could_not_verify: A live merge on GitHub: the fix is proven against the sequencer and custody libraries with real local git repos only (TRD Could Not Verify, row 1; the TRD's Verification Environment names github-live-test as the place for it but places it outside this fix's scope).

Merge step handed out again from main after the branch is deleted: the custody gate's reconcile --head <PR head> compares local HEAD with the PR head (custody.js:337-345) and refuses when main holds base commits the PR head lacks; the resumed run then stops again at the merge step with its record kept. Fixing that gate behaviour is outside this TRD (TRD Could Not Verify, row 2).
open_questions: OQ-1: Should detaching custody.json delete the tracked copy ("moving")? Assumed: copied out; the tracked copy is left untouched and never written again, like shipped.json, because deleting it would dirty the merged branch. Owner-only.
